description: Every span endpoint must snap to a network node within 0.1 meters.
query: WITH endpoints AS (SELECT id AS span_id, name, ST_StartPoint(geom) AS start_pt, ST_EndPoint(geom) AS end_pt FROM spans) SELECT e.span_id, e.name, 'Start or end point not connected to any node' AS failure_reason FROM endpoints e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE ST_DWithin(e.start_pt::geography, n.geom::geography, 0.1)) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE ST_DWithin(e.end_pt::geography, n.geom::geography, 0.1));

description: Spans must exceed 1.0 meter to prevent digitizing artifacts.
query: SELECT id AS span_id, name, ROUND(ST_Length(geom::geography)::numeric, 2) || 'm is below minimum threshold (1.0m)' AS failure_reason FROM spans WHERE ST_Length(geom::geography) < 1.0;

description: Feeder cables cannot terminate directly at a premise location.
query: WITH feeder_endpoints AS (SELECT id AS cable_id, ST_EndPoint(geom) AS end_pt FROM cables WHERE type = 'FEEDER') SELECT f.cable_id, 'Feeder cable illegally terminated at premise ' || p.id AS failure_reason FROM feeder_endpoints f JOIN premises p ON ST_DWithin(f.end_pt::geography, p.geom::geography, 0.1);

description: Underground equipment must be placed inside a vault polygon.
query: SELECT e.id AS equip_id, 'Equipment is not contained within any vault boundary' AS failure_reason FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN vaults v ON ST_Intersects(e.geom, v.geom) WHERE v.id IS NULL;
